title: Corrected zero-render arithmetic localization and local risk-bound derivation for D12.5-C2 static interior extrema
question: What arithmetic terms produce the fresh D12.5-C2 distance-17 and distance-4 maxima, and can a local bilinear contrast bound conservatively upper-bound every radius-2/radius-3 interior RGB error without using silhouette distance as a universal explanation?
decisionRole: post-hoc development diagnostic and bound derivation; not a holdout and not an adaptive-gate validation

correctionContract.reason: The first frozen localizer read bilinear taps at an image-edge pixel before testing coordinate eligibility and exited before writing or exposing any measurement.
correctionContract.onlyPermittedScientificCodeDelta: In reconstruction replay only, derive sample coordinates, test bounds, and reject the pixel before calling the helper that reads tap values. All arithmetic, evidence, samples, statistics, thresholds and decisions remain byte-for-byte or semantically unchanged.

frozenInputs.forbidden: No invalid-run artifact, D12.3 array or newly rendered input may enter a D12.6 measurement.

identityBeforeMeasurement: verify all four parent file and internal hashes
verify every bound adapter/consumer report and payload hash
verify repeat-1/repeat-2 source and consumer payload identity
recompute every radius-2 and radius-3 reconstructed float32 byte
analysisContract.maximumTotality: For every fixture/radius, enumerate every pixel/channel tied at the formal RGB maximum; do not retain only the first coordinate.
sampleRecord: raw Vector values and float32 bits
four tap coordinates and RGB values
signed per-tap contributions relative to current center

localRiskBound.definition: For each RGB channel, sum over four taps: abs(weight_i) * abs(previousTap_i - currentCenter), then add one full float32 ULP at the magnitude of the pre-cast reconstruction. Pixel risk is the maximum channel bound.
localRiskBound.requiredProperty: For every radius-interior RGB sample in all six primary cells, actual absolute error <= registered local risk bound; underbound count must be zero.
reportOnly: Spearman rank association between pixel risk and actual RGB maximum
recall and selected-pixel fraction at the frozen production gate and half-gate
owner/distance groups for top 64 actual-error and risk samples

requires: all identity and float32 replay checks pass
independent audit reproduces every maximum, sample record and aggregate
at least 18 registered mutation attacks are rejected

nonClaims: D12.6 is not a fresh holdout and cannot support an adaptive production gate.
A conservative bound may be too loose to be useful; usefulness metrics are report-only here.
No causal claim about Blender internals follows from image-space arithmetic replay.
D12.5-C2 and D12.3 verdicts remain unchanged.
Motion, deformation, transparency, hair, particles, volumes, motion blur, disocclusion and perceptual quality remain out of scope.
